title: Experiment
description: Schema for the Experiment section of the workflow

DATELIST.description: List of dates to run the simulation.

MEMBERS.description: Name of ensemble members, each matching fcN. The realization is derived from the name: fcN -> realization N+1, so the list need not start at fc0. (Example: fc0 fc1 fc2, or fc10 fc11 to start at realization 11)

CHUNKSIZE.description: Size of the chunk, in CHUNKSIZEUNITs.
